---
title: lomi. Radar
description: Screen incoming card and mobile-money charges with risk assessments, webhooks, and metered billing.
---

import { Callout } from '@/components/docs/docs-callout';

**lomi. Radar** evaluates **incoming** charges (card, MTN, Wave) before they complete. Every charge gets a **Normal**, **Risky**, or **Blocked** label on the transaction. It is separate from [Disputes](/build/money/disputes) (card chargebacks after the fact) and from platform payout controls described in [Payouts](/build/money/payouts).

<Callout type="info">
  Screening is always on. Merchants choose monitor vs block. Platform rules (including unverified accounts taking USD or EUR cards) cannot be turned off.
</Callout>

## Mode

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.lomi.africa/organizations/radar-settings" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "mode": "block" }'
```

| Field | Values | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `monitor` | Mark risky charges but allow them |
| `mode` | `block` | Reject charges that trigger block rules |
| `stripe_radar_passthrough` | `true` (default) | Merge card-network risk signals after card capture |
| `enabled` | ignored for screening | Metering preference only |

Dashboard Settings → Radar shows the same mode control. Risky and blocked charges also create an in-app notification.

## Built-in rules

| Rule | Rails | Default action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `high_value_charge` | card, MTN, Wave | Flag ≥ 500,000 XOF equivalent |
| `velocity_charges_1h` | all | Block > 20 charges / customer / hour |
| `repeat_phone_24h` | MTN, Wave | Flag same phone across customers |
| `card_country_mismatch` | card | Flag billing country outside WAEMU |
| `unverified_card_foreign_currency` | card | Flag USD/EUR cards on unverified accounts (platform) |

## List risk assessments

```bash
curl "https://api.lomi.africa/risk-assessments?decision=flag&page=1&pageSize=50" \
  -H "X-API-KEY: $LOMI_SECRET_KEY"
```

Optional filters: `decision` (`allow`, `flag`, `block`), `rail` (`card`, `mtn`, `wave`), `startDate`, `endDate`.

Example row:

```json
{
  "assessment_id": "…",
  "transaction_id": "…",
  "rail": "mtn",
  "decision": "flag",
  "risk_score": 45,
  "signals": [{ "rule": "repeat_phone_24h", "action": "flag", "detail": "…" }],
  "amount": 10000,
  "currency_code": "XOF"
}
```

## Webhooks

Subscribe to:

- `PAYMENT_RISK_FLAGGED`, charge allowed but flagged for review
- `PAYMENT_RISK_BLOCKED`, charge blocked when `mode` is `block`

Payload includes `assessment_id`, `transaction_id`, `rail`, `decision`, `risk_score`, `signals`, `amount`, and `currency_code`.

## Disputes vs Radar vs payout controls

| | **Disputes** | **Radar** | **Payout controls** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Timing | After chargeback | Before/during charge | At withdrawal |
| API | `GET /disputes` | `GET /risk-assessments` | None (internal) |
| Dashboard | Settings → Support → Disputes | Transaction sheet: Normal / Risky / Blocked | Withdrawal error message |

## Metering

When a `radar_screen` meter is configured, each screening can emit a usage event billed through [Usage billing](/build/billing/usage-billing). Platform screening still runs without a meter.
